notes.title: Hotfix D0.01
notes.notes:
Hello! The Demo is out and with that, bugs arise! Here is a quick patch to squash the most annoying ones and add some tweaks.

Fixes

 Corrected known spelling errors on some menus
 Remove extra sock from House 2
 Add collider behind House 3 bed to prevent items from falling behind


Tweaks

 Adjust House 1 Tutorial Text
 Update dice model and texture
 Rename some objects from plural to singular
 Rename [spoiler]Pink Burrito Roll[/spoiler] to [spoiler]Purple Burrito Roll[/spoiler]
 Adjust some item positions in Forest 3
